name: How do infinity edge pools work on sloped lots?

mainEntity.name: How does an infinity edge pool function on a hillside property, and what does it require to build correctly?
mainEntity.text: How does an infinity edge pool function on a hillside property, and what does it require to build correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: An infinity edge pool creates the appearance that the water flows over the horizon, but the effect depends on careful engineering. The overflow edge drops into a catch basin, where the water is collected and pumped back into the main pool. On hillside properties, the design must account for slope, retaining structures, structural loads, and drainage so the edge performs consistently without overflow problems. The visual effect is strongest when the pool is oriented toward a view, which is why these designs are popular in elevated Los Angeles neighborhoods. The system also needs proper hydraulic sizing so the water level stays stable and the edge remains visually clean. Homeowners should ask about maintenance access, equipment placement, and what happens during high winds or heavy use. Infinity edge pools are striking, but they are more technical than standard pools and should be designed by a team experienced in hillside construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Infinity edge pools use a lower catch basin to collect water that spills over one edge and recirculate it back to the pool. On sloped lots, they require precise grading, structural support, drainage, and pump design to work properly and safely.
